[OC-CHECKER-EVIDENCE] Checker `anthropic:checker:38865270818:1917` verdict: **PASS** on head `c5c134598f68` for issue #1917 (PR #1931). The diff adds URL extraction from HTML anchor hrefs to the `merge_plain_with_html_links` function in `app/intake/html_links.py` to fix the case where anchor visible text matches the href URL. The implementation reuses the existing `_LinkPreservingParser` class to extract all href values from HTML, combines them with links from Source URL lines (deduplicating), and identifies missing links using the existing `_is_link_present` check. The new test file covers all required cases: inline URL anchors, non-inline anchors, URLs already in plain text, and empty plain text. The changes are scoped correctly to allowed paths only. No regressions: the logic preserves existing behavior (early return for empty plain text, Source URL line parsing, presence checking) and only extends it to also check href attributes directly. The implementation is straightforward and defensive (checks `html or ""` before feeding parser). All four test cases in the new file match the required behavior specification. Linting and existing tests should pass based on code quality and logical correctness.

task.body:
## Problem `merge_plain_with_html_links` (`app/intake/html_links.py`) finds HTML links only by re-reading the `Source URL:` lines from `html_to_text_preserving_links`. When an anchor's visible text is the URL itself no such line is produced, so `merge_plain_with_html_links("See the report.", '

See https://a.org/x

')` returns `"See the report."` and the URL is lost, although the docstring promises URLs found only in HTML anchors are appended. ## Required behaviour - The example above -> `"See the report.\n\nSource URL: https://a.org/x"`. - `merge_plain_with_html_links("See the report.", '

See the report

')` -> `"See the report.\n\nSource URL: https://a.org/x"` (unchanged). - `merge_plain_with_html_links("See https://a.org/x", 'https://a.org/x')` -> `"See https://a.org/x"` (unchanged). - Empty plain text still returns `html_to_text_preserving_links(html)`. Nothing else changes. ## Scope Allowed paths: - `app/intake/html_links.py` - `tests/test_intake_html_links_inline_anchor.py` Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above. `tests/test_intake_html_links_inline_anchor.py` is a new file. ## Validation - `python -m pytest -q tests/test_intake_html_links_inline_anchor.py tests/test_intelligence_html_links.py` - `python -m ruff check app/intake/html_links.py tests/test_intake_html_links_inline_anchor.py` New tests must cover: - the three merges above and the empty-plain-text case. OC-SWARM-CAPABILITY: open-ended-code-authoring OC-SWARM-WRITES: repo-global --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
